name: Potential DoS/DDoS Attack on ISP-Managed External Destinations
description: Detects abnormally high volumes of outbound traffic targeting ISP-managed external destination IPs originating from non-private/non-RFC1918 source addresses. A sustained count exceeding 75,000 events within a 30-minute window represents approximately 2.5x the observed normal baseline (~25,000–30,000 events/30min) and may indicate a volumetric Denial of Service (DoS) or Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) attack in progress. Private/internal RFC1918 source ranges are excluded to focus on externally-sourced traffic only.
query:
FROM logs-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= NOW() - 15 minutes
| WHERE destination.ip IN (
    "185.27.117.243", "109.224.43.214",
    "109.224.43.213", "185.27.117.246"
  )
| WHERE NOT CIDR_MATCH(source.ip, "10.0.0.0/8", "192.168.0.0/16", "172.16.0.0/12")
| STATS
    event_count = COUNT(*),
    first_seen  = MIN(@timestamp),
    last_seen   = MAX(@timestamp)
    BY destination.ip, source.ip
| WHERE event_count >= 500
| EVAL ip_group = CASE(
    destination.ip IN ("185.27.117.243", "109.224.43.214"), "Group-A",
    destination.ip IN ("109.224.43.213", "185.27.117.246"), "Group-B",
    "Unknown"
  )
| EVAL threshold_breach = CASE(
    ip_group == "Group-A" AND event_count >= 40000, true,
    ip_group == "Group-B" AND event_count >= 15000, true,
    false
  )
| EVAL attack_type = CASE(
    event_count >= 40000, "CRITICAL - Primary Attacker",
    event_count >= 20000, "HIGH - Major Contributor",
    event_count >= 10000, "MEDIUM - Contributor",
    "LOW - Monitor"
  )
| WHERE threshold_breach == true
| SORT event_count DESC
